components.name: action
components.summary: A button that posts, with an optional confirm: leave, remove, stop.

components.name: answer
components.summary: The answer first, then its rows, then what to do next.

components.name: ask-agent
components.summary: The chip that asks: a tap hands the question to your own agent in the Dock, with this page's context, and it never sends for you.

components.name: badge
components.summary: A word beside a title: live, new, a state. Five tones.

components.name: button
components.summary: One clear action: primary, quiet, ghost or danger. A link with href, a form button without.

components.name: card
components.summary: A stream, a clip, a room or a place: picture first, the title, who, and one line.

components.name: chart
components.summary: Line, area, bar or scatter. Text stays its real size at every width, and a table with the same numbers sits behind it.

components.name: chips
components.summary: Filters you can turn on and off, or one of a few.

components.name: dock
components.summary: The one thing you type, pinned at the bottom. Enter sends; it grows as you write.

components.name: dot
components.summary: How many are new. Nothing at zero; 9+ past nine.

components.name: drop
components.summary: Where a file goes: a real file input, plus drag and drop, paste and the phone's camera.

components.name: empty
components.summary: What a page says when there is nothing yet, and the one thing to do about it.

components.name: family
components.summary: The tools next to this one.

components.name: find
components.summary: A search, or "add by name": a pill with an icon, the field and a round button.

components.name: fold
components.summary: A card that opens: setup, extras, the danger zone. It says what is inside and how much.

components.name: head
components.summary: The top of an app page: back, the title, one muted line, icon actions and the tabs. It sticks under the navbar.

components.name: home-edit
components.summary: The menu's Edit button: turns arranging Home on, and says Done while dragging and removing apps is on.

components.name: home-grid
components.summary: The menu's Home screen: your apps in a grid you arrange by long-press or Edit, with folders and the app drawer.

components.name: icon-button
components.summary: An action that is only an icon. Its label is what a screen reader says and what the tooltip shows.

components.name: labels
components.summary: What a stream, recording, picture or post carries (nudity, strong language, graphic, 18+, flashing lights, spoilers), in words. Only the labels in force: a suggestion is the creator's to confirm. The page marks the thing itself with kit.labelsAttr so each viewer's own choice (show, blur, hide) applies.

components.name: list
components.summary: Rows under a title, with a link to all of them.

components.name: mark
components.summary: A person or a place: their picture, or up to two letters on a colour that comes from the name.

components.name: meter
components.summary: How full something is. With tone auto, a limit turns amber from 75 % and red from 90 %.

components.name: more
components.summary: The rest of a row's actions, behind one button. Dangerous ones confirm.

components.name: notice
components.summary: A sentence about what just happened: ok, info, warn or error. Errors are announced.

components.name: num
components.summary: A number the way a reader wants it: money, compact, percent, time. Missing is "–", never 0.

components.name: page
components.summary: The whole shape of an app page in one call; the side column sits beside the content from 1024 px, under it below.

components.name: page-head
components.summary: The top of a page: the way back, the page's icon and title, its actions, and one line saying what it is for.

components.name: rail
components.summary: A row of cards that scrolls sideways on a phone and wraps on a computer when asked. A long list never makes a long page.

components.name: range-row
components.summary: An amount: the label, the slider and its value.

components.name: rank
components.summary: A leaderboard: the place, the name, the value with its interval, the change, a bar in proportion.

components.name: receipt
components.summary: A result and what it took: the answer first, then one quiet line of facts.

components.name: row
components.summary: A mark, the title with a badge and the time on one line, one muted line under it. The whole row is the link.

components.name: save-bar
components.summary: The save button of a settings form, kept in reach above the phone's app bar.

components.name: section
components.summary: A titled block of a page, with its count and one quiet note.

components.name: seg
components.summary: Two to four choices you can see at once.

components.name: segmented
components.summary: Three or four equal choices filling the row, each with an icon; the radios post without JavaScript.

components.name: select-row
components.summary: One choice of several, as a row.

components.name: share
components.summary: The one Share button: it opens the network's Share sheet, or copies the link where there is no sheet.

components.name: sheet
components.summary: More choices without leaving the page: up from the bottom on a phone, a dialog on a computer.

components.name: sidebar
components.summary: Navigation down the left on a computer, a drawer on a phone.

components.name: skeleton
components.summary: The shape of what is coming, so nothing jumps when it arrives. It never spins.

components.name: snippet
components.summary: Code to copy, with a copy button in the corner.

components.name: stats
components.summary: A strip of numbers that matter. Zero and unknown are left out; it scrolls sideways on a phone.

components.name: steps
components.summary: A flow of a few steps. Done steps link back; later ones never link ahead.

components.name: switch-row
components.summary: An on/off setting: the label and a hint on the left, the switch on the right.

components.name: table
components.summary: Plans, prices, endpoints: anything compared across columns. On a phone each row becomes a card.

components.name: tabs
components.summary: Links, so they work without JavaScript. For settings and explainers, never to hide content.

components.name: tool
components.summary: One order for every tool page: head, input, answer, family, folds, related.

components.name: tool-head
components.summary: What the tool does, in its colour, with the facts that matter (free, no sign-in, what is kept).

components.name: tool-input
components.summary: The one field a tool needs, its button, and examples to try.

components.name: tries
components.summary: Examples a person can run with one tap.
